purpose: Test whether replacing the absolute nearest-prototype score (score = -d1) by a RELATIVE score that cancels a cross-session additive offset delta (margin = d2 - d1, ratio = -d1/d2, mix = -d1 + lam*(d2-d1)) raises Test S2 acceptance above 0.60 while the Train-side LOSO unknown rejection stays at 0.90 and Test S1 rejection stays above 0.95. Everything else is the frozen E228/E233 pipeline: the E227 deploy model (task-wise standardisation, sqrt(w_b) block weights, PCA96, k=12 prototypes per (task, identity)), the strict 20-fold subject-LOSO protocol, the inner 5-block OOF threshold rule, and the E233 per-(session, task) unlabeled mean alignment.

predecessor.frozen_baseline: E228 frozen e226_auc2W: E227 deploy_auc2_lofo.pt representation, task-wise standardisation on all-20-identity fit rows, sqrt(w_b) auc2_lofo block weights, PCA96, k=12 prototypes per (task, identity), tau = (1-A) quantile of the deploy model inner 5-block OOF known scores with A bisected on Train so that pooled LOSO unknown rejection hits 0.90.
failed_do_not_repeat: raw-waveform in-fold retraining with drift augmentation
four-quadrant feature ablation at fixed LOSO 0.90 (E231)
CORAL on this data (E233, separation AUC collapses to 0.57)

feature_cache.note: Only reads predecessor artifacts; E234 writes inside research/E234_offset_invariant_score/ only. No historical experiment is modified.

representation.pipeline: byte-identical to E228 e226_auc2W: task-wise z-score on fit rows -> sqrt(w_b) block weights (per fold: auc_lofo^2 mean over the other 19 folds, normalised to mean 1; deploy model: frozen E227 weights) -> subtract fit mean pm, multiply PCA W -> k=12 k-means prototypes per (task, identity). Nothing is refitted for the Test read-out; the frozen E227 deploy model is used.
representation.fold_refit_note: The 20 held-identity folds ARE recomputed here because margin/ratio need d2, which the E227 caches do not store. The fold code is a verbatim copy of E227's fit/transform/score; d1 is cross-checked against the E227 cached score per fold.

protocol.open_set_direction: high score = known; unknown is the positive class for rejection F1 and AUC

scoring_variants.abs: score = -d1, d1 = distance to the nearest same-task prototype (E228 reference)
scoring_variants.margin: score = d2 - d1, d2 = distance to the nearest prototype of a DIFFERENT identity in the same task. Translation of both distances by a common offset cancels in the difference.
scoring_variants.ratio: score = -d1 / d2 (negated so that high = known); invariant to a multiplicative rescaling of all distances
scoring_variants.mix: score = -d1 + lam * (d2 - d1), lam fixed in config; interpolates between abs (lam=0) and margin-dominated (lam>1)
scoring_variants.distance_rule: d1 and d2 are computed within the SAME task; d2 excludes every prototype whose identity equals the nearest prototype's identity. Euclidean distance in the frozen PCA96 space.
scoring_variants.why: score = -d1 is not invariant to an additive cross-session offset: a shift delta that increases every distance of a registered user lowers the score uniformly. A relative score removes the common part of the shift at the level of each row.

threshold.rule: tau = (1-A) quantile of the candidate's own inner 5-block OOF known scores (fit rows, all 20 identities); A is bisected on Train so that the pooled (micro) LOSO unknown rejection is the largest value still >= 0.90 (E228 rule, identical code path).
threshold.note: Every candidate gets its own A and tau because the score scale changes with the metric; the calibration uses Train rows only. Test is read once per candidate after the freeze.

alignment.mean_align: E233 winner, copied verbatim: per (session, task) remove the unlabeled batch mean in the frozen PCA space and add back the per-task train fit-row mean. Applied with one identical rule to both sessions; session is only a batch key.
alignment.note: Only margin/ratio/abs are evaluated with and without mean_align. Batch statistics are transductive (grey zone).

abs_dist.role: reproduction control: must reproduce E233 mean_align S1 1.0 / S2 0.312155 / sepAUC 0.879522

abs_dist_cal.role: same metric as the control but with its own calibrated A, so the comparison to the relative metrics is at identical LOSO=0.90

loso: per-fold unknown rejection and known acceptance (mean +- std)
metrics.delta_cancellation: mean score on Test session1 vs session2, raw gap, pooled-sd standardised gap, and per-(session, task) cell means, for abs vs margin vs ratio vs mix on the UNALIGNED space (that is where delta exists). A relative score cancels delta if its standardised S1-S2 gap is materially smaller than the abs one.

purity.space: frozen baseline PCA space (no alignment) so the cluster partition is identical across candidates
purity.rows: all Test session2 rows (19218), no subsampling
purity.init: random sample init, 60 Lloyd iterations, chunked distances
purity.primary: micro share of S2 rows whose predicted identity equals the mode identity of their cluster

bootstrap.targets: paired row bootstrap of S2 acceptance difference vs abs_dist_cal, and vs abs_dist

decision_rule.hard_requirement: LOSO unknown rejection in [0.89, 0.91] AND Test S1 rejection >= 0.95 AND Test S2 acceptance >= 0.60 AND purity micro >= 0.95 * baseline purity micro (k=20 and k=28)
decision_rule.partial: best eligible S2 in [0.45, 0.60) -> report 'significant improvement but below the user requirement' and name the remaining bottleneck
decision_rule.fail: best S2 <= 0.3122 (the E233 compliant value) -> state that the relative score is ineffective on this data and give the evidence
decision_rule.tie_break: S2 under the matched S1 = 0.95 gate

official_note: Official Test C / RA / ASafeR are N/A: Test has no identity labels. The session-level S1 rejection >= 0.95 is a reviewer-imposed proxy, not an official metric.
bias_note: Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65, so every S2 number carries a repeated-inspection bias. Session and registration status are confounded (E232: S1 = 5 unregistered subjects, S2 = 20 registered users), so S1/S2 are behavioural proxies, not clean biometric metrics. The mean_align statistics are estimated from the unlabeled batch being scored (transductive grey zone).
